name: SendBird AI Chatbot
description: SendBird AI Chatbot is a powerful tool designed to enhance communication by integrating AI-driven chat capabilities into your applications. It allows businesses to automate customer interactions, provide instant support, and improve user engagement through intelligent conversation management.
